# @vllnt/convex-buckets

> Ephemeral groups of opaque subject refs as a Convex component

`@vllnt/convex-buckets` is a Convex component. Install `@vllnt/convex-buckets`
(unreleased builds from `main` use the `canary` dist-tag). It targets `convex@^1.45.0`.
It stores two sandboxed tables — `buckets` (`bucketRef`, `status` open/locked/closed, `capacity`,
`memberCount`, timestamps) and `members` (`bucketRef`, `subjectRef`, `joinedAt`). `open` creates a
group; `join` / `leave` mutate membership; `lock` stops joins; `close` is terminal. Capacity is
OCC-safe because `join` patches `memberCount` on the bucket row. `listMembers` is bounded (default
100, max 500); use `paginateMembers(ctx, bucketRef, paginationOpts, scope?)` for cursor traversal.
`eraseBucket` closes and recounts atomically, reserving the ref until cleanup completes;
continuations are fenced by document ID. `eraseSubject` deletes one bounded batch per call and schedules no continuation: the host blocks joins and repeats calls until zero. It is not a permanent ban. The host
owns auth and the meaning of the group. Distinct from `@vllnt/convex-memberships` (standing
org/roles) and `@convex-dev/presence` (liveness).

Client option `defaultScope` defaults to `"global"`. `open` options are
`{ bucketRef?, capacity?, scope? }`; omitted refs are generated, omitted capacity
means no component-level member cap. `get` returns `{ bucketRef, status,
memberCount, openedAt, capacity?, lockedAt?, closedAt? }` or null. Erasure batches
default to 200 and clamp to 500. Named mounts isolate state and scheduled work.
No automatic expiry, React entry or heartbeat is provided.
